title: McNemar: MediSync outbreak rule vs fixed 95th-percentile threshold

environment.pValueMethod: exact binomial in integer arithmetic (SciPy/statsmodels blocked by Windows Application Control on this machine)

dataset.name: OpenDengue national extract V1.3.1
dataset.note: One national weekly count is fed as one detector day: a proxy for the production daily district detector.

thresholdSource: 95th percentile of the 62 weeks before the first evaluated week (out of sample)
limits: Exact McNemar assumes independent weeks. These weeks are serially dependent and 49 of the 50 strict outbreak weeks belong to one epidemic (2017), so the p-values overstate the evidence.
One disease, one country, national weekly totals: this tests the rule on a proxy series, not the live platform.
Non-significance on a subset is not evidence that the two methods are equivalent.
